summary: Allow an explicit SQLite store directory without moving the product state root or its external message bodies.

replay.detail: Selecting store_dir does not replay or move existing claims. Offline logical backup export and restore retain their existing replay and digest checks.

schema.detail: No database schema change. Only claims.sqlite3 and its WAL and SHM sidecars use the configured store directory; the default remains state_dir.

rules.detail: Claim admission, replication, retention and checkpoint rules are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Config accepts an optional store_dir and up accepts --store-dir. Existing configurations keep their original database path. Backups of the configured database continue to read and restore external message bodies under the product state root even when SQLite is elsewhere.

downtime.detail: Relocating an existing store requires stopping only the daemon, excluding other database users, and completing a TRUNCATE checkpoint with busy=0 before copying the trio. Agents and PTY servers must not be stopped as part of this procedure.

manual.detail: No files move automatically. Follow docs/st3/backups.md: privately retain a rollback copy, copy and verify each existing trio member and identity, remove the original active trio, set an absolute store_dir in the daemon's effective config, then restart only the daemon. Leave all other product files in state_dir.

recovery.detail: Rollback requires an offline verified trio and matching configuration. If writes occurred after relocation, checkpoint and move the current store back rather than restoring the stale original snapshot. Never mix sidecars from different snapshots or run duplicate writer identities.
